valueMarkdown.value: This value set was deprecated in AU Base 7.0.0 and is replaced by use of the [Jurisdiction ValueSet](http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/jurisdiction) value set. The Australian additions in this value set duplicate concepts for Australian states and territories that are already available in the Jurisdiction ValueSet from the urn:iso:std:iso:3166:-2 code system, and so are invalid for use against an extensible binding to that value set.

description.value:
This value set is deprecated and replaced by use of the [Jurisdiction ValueSet](http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/jurisdiction) value set, which already includes concepts for Australian states and territories from the urn:iso:std:iso:3166:-2 code system.
Jurisdiction ValueSet extended for use in an Australian context. Includes HL7 international codes plus Australian additions to create a complete set.
